name: Four-Vertex Path
definition: Take $P=\{p\}$, $R=\{q,e\}$, $A=\{q\}$, and $\mathcal W=\{\varnothing,\{q\},\{e\}\}$ in the construction $O(P,R,A;\mathcal W)$.
properties: The resulting graph is $P_4$. It is a path, tree, median graph, maximum class, and learning-space graph. It is neither a star nor a daisy cube, and every proper pc-minor is a path and a star.
